role: Ministre des Sports, de la Jeunesse et de la Vie associative
description: Minister of Sports, Youth and Community Life. First appointed on 5 October 2025 in the first (short-lived) Lecornu government and reappointed on 12 October 2025 in the second Lecornu government; retained in the post through the 26 February 2026 reshuffle. Portfolio includes sport policy, the 2024 Olympic/Paralympic legacy and 'loi olympique', football governance, youth and the associative (non-profit) sector.

role: Ministre déléguée chargée de l'Économie du tourisme
organization: Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances (PM Michel Barnier)
description: Minister-Delegate for the Tourism Economy under PM Michel Barnier, attached to the Ministry of the Economy and Finance. Net remuneration declared to HATVP: 30,379 EUR for 2024.

organization: Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances (PM Gabriel Attal)
description: Secretary of State for Digital Affairs under PM Gabriel Attal, attached to the Ministry of the Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty. Defended the SREN law (securing and regulating the digital space) before Parliament and oversaw implementation of EU digital texts (DSA/DMA). Net remuneration declared to HATVP: 49,676 EUR for 2024.

Member of the National Assembly for Savoie's 1st constituency (Aix-les-Bains), elected in June 2022 and re-elected at the 2024 snap legislative elections. Sat with the centrist groups (MoDem / Les Démocrates) and on the Finance Committee. Mandate suspended while serving in government per the rule on incompatibility; her substitute (suppléant) sits in her stead during ministerial service.

role: Responsable administratif et RH (administrative and HR manager)
description: Administrative and human-resources manager at Lunabee Studio, a Chambéry (Savoie) digital start-up developing native iOS/Android applications. Declared net remuneration (2019-2022 portion of the role) to HATVP: 12,664 EUR (2019), 16,765 EUR (2020), 27,179 EUR (2021), 17,952 EUR (2022).

role: Conseillère départementale, Vice-présidente du Département de la Savoie
description: Departmental councillor and Vice-President of the Savoie department (canton d'Aix-les-Bains). HATVP records the mandate's later years (2019: 24,559 EUR net; 2020: 20,217 EUR; 2021: 9,973 EUR until June 2021).

role: Adjointe au maire d'Aix-les-Bains / Conseillère municipale
description: Long-standing municipal elected official in Aix-les-Bains, including deputy mayor responsibilities (school affairs, economic affairs and finance). HATVP records 'Adjoint au Maire d'Aix les Bains' to December 2019 and 'Conseillère municipale Aix les Bains' continuing since December 2019.

role: Conseillère communautaire / Vice-présidente Chambéry Grand Lac Économie
organization: Grand Lac agglomération / Chambéry Grand Lac Économie
description: Intercommunal elected official: Vice-President of Chambéry Grand Lac Économie and delegated/community councillor of Grand Lac agglomération. HATVP records these intercommunal mandates from 2019, with the community-councillor seat continuing from July 2020.

role: Présidente de la fédération départementale du MoDem (Savoie)
description: President of the Savoie departmental federation of the Mouvement Démocrate since November 2020. Unpaid (0 EUR declared each year to HATVP).
